messages.content: Hi, been trying to eat better. What should I eat instead of bread? Dr said I need to watch my diet.
Hi! I'm really glad you're working on your diet. But I can't give diet advice—that's something our nurses do. Want me to connect you with one?
yeah, how long would that take?
Our nurses usually get back in about 31 hours. Sound okay?
Got it. Connecting you now. Did you take your meds today?
Perfect, I logged that. You're doing great. We'll check in next week.

theme: diet question, what to eat instead of bread
